laws_and_bills.name: Executive Order 658 (Healey) on large data centers
laws_and_bills.what: Signed 2026-09-08. Data centers (new or expanded) with peak demand over 25 MW cannot get state permits unless they follow the June 2026 state framework and sign a community benefits agreement meeting OEJE guidelines; must buy incremental clean electricity or pay alternative compliance payments; bans state agency NDAs with data centers; MassDEP payment mechanism and municipal guidance due by Dec 31. Executive order, not a statute.

laws_and_bills.name: Statewide initiative petition requiring local voter approval of data centers
laws_and_bills.what: Filed by Jim Fleming (West Springfield): no local permit for a data center until utility cost protections, water certification and a drought plan are in place and two-thirds of local voters approve. AG review due Sept 2; about 75,000 signatures needed by early December; could reach the 2028 ballot.

laws_and_bills.name: S 3166 (Senate energy bill) with data center amendment (Sen. Vanna Howard)
laws_and_bills.what: Energy bill in conference committee includes a data center amendment.

laws_and_bills.name: HD5404 and SB3213 (2025-2026)
laws_and_bills.what: HD5404 would protect residential customers from data center electricity costs; SB3213 would set broader requirements on large data centers.

incentives.name: Data center sales tax exemption
incentives.what: 20-year sales tax exemption for data centers; final regulations issued by the Executive Office of Economic Development in March 2026 require applicants to disclose peak energy demand; new applications paused in June 2026 with no restart date.
